div.p: Context: cards must be created as the user; two independent origins. Decision: scoped personal access token (Bearer), not an ambient session cookie. Consequences (+): decoupled identities; revocable; least privilege; no SameSite fragility. Consequences (−): one-time manual token paste; Fluency must issue/verify tokens. First law: everything is a trade-off — we bought decoupling with a little setup friction.
